DDInter1921.mechanism: The antidiuretic response to vasopressin or desmopressin may be potentiated by certain drugs, including nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory agents, selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, tricyclic/tetracyclic antidepressants, carbamazepine, chlorpropamide, chlorpromazine, clofibrate, eslicarbazepine, fludrocortisone, haloperidol, lamotrigine, oxcarbazepine, urea, and some antineoplastic agents (e.g., vinca alkaloids, cisplatin, cyclophosphamide).
